title: P0.1 process-aware energy + optimal aggregation vs self-consistency on HEADROOM (v6)

field_provenance.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_.
field_provenance.benchmark_id: the headroom benchmark scored (distinct from GSM8K).
field_provenance.n_problems_heldout: held-out problems scored; >=20 preliminary, >=40 headline-eligible (with CV).
field_provenance.self_consistency_in_headroom_band: SC in [0.4,0.78] — the property that makes a selector-vs-SC test meaningful (unlike GSM8K).
field_provenance.self_consistency_accuracy: majority vote over k — the PRIMARY control (held-out).
field_provenance.process_energy_argmin_accuracy: FoVer step-level PROCESS energy argmin — the .320 new condition (per-step, not candidate-level).
field_provenance.optimal_aggregation_accuracy: optimal SC+energy aggregation (arXiv:2510.13918) — THE headline condition.
field_provenance.flip_count_optimal_vs_sc: problems where optimal-aggregation differs from SC — the tautology-clean primary signal (0 -> the two agree, no separate bit-identical field).
field_provenance.flips_correct_optimal: flips that became CORRECT (the win mechanism: recovering minority-yet-correct answers).
field_provenance.net_correctness_gain_optimal: flips_correct - flips_incorrect for optimal aggregation — the honest net effect, robust to ceiling-induced ties.
field_provenance.delta_optimal_vs_self_consistency: optimal-aggregation minus SC at matched compute — THE headline delta.
field_provenance.delta_process_energy_vs_self_consistency: process-energy argmin minus SC — does per-step verification route into selection?
field_provenance.paired_significance: McNemar exact p + paired bootstrap CI95 for the optimal, process-energy, and hybrid deltas.
field_provenance.compute_parity_note: per-condition generation budget + reranker/aggregator params so energy does not win by spending more compute.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: content hash of corpus + reranker config + split + seed.
field_provenance.duration_s: cached scoring + small-model training; 1s floor (no live model — why it cannot time out).

methodology_note: HEADROOM corpus has only n=21 usable problems (<40); exp3471 (the corpus builder) resumes to grow it. No energy comparison is reported on an under-powered corpus.
